text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Record the durability mode actually used**

When operator configuration forces durability mode on, these fields say the campaign used that configuration, but neither `buildRecallPrompt` nor `runPrecisionPass` resolves or passes a `durabilityMode` to `buildReviewPrompt`, so the benchmark requests omit the durability instructions and mode document. This can make precision evidence appear configuration-matched to real PR reviews where durability mode was active even though their prompts differ; either apply the recorded mode to the benchmark requests or record its actual inactive/unavailable resolution.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed by recording the actual state rather than applying the mode. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
